subject.title: fix(ui): show cross-agent child sessions in the sidebar on request

question: Should the Control UI sidebar offer a user-initiated, default-off All agents mode that makes persisted child/spawned sessions from other configured agent scopes discoverable and openable?
rationale: The patch is deliberately localized and does not alter protocol, persistence, or the default view, but the appropriate cross-agent transcript-discovery boundary is a product policy choice rather than a correctness question.

options.title: Approve the default-off sidebar mode
options.body: Accept the explicit operator-controlled cross-agent discovery path while retaining scoped default behavior and the existing non-session exclusions.

options.title: Keep sidebar discovery scoped
options.body: Decline the new visibility mode and direct cross-agent task/session discovery to the existing task-oriented surfaces instead.

options.title: Request a narrower policy design
options.body: Pause this PR if the intended audience, labels, or session types need a more explicit visibility policy before exposing the control.

recommendation.title: Approve the default-off sidebar mode
recommendation.body: Accept the explicit operator-controlled cross-agent discovery path while retaining scoped default behavior and the existing non-session exclusions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Control UI work covers discovery and opening of child-session work, so this is the strongest available adjacent routing signal.
